## How did you test it?

- [ ] `composer test`, `composer lint` and `composer analyse` pass
- [ ] `composer docs` run if `workbench/app/Catalog.php` changed
- [ ] Checked in the catalog (`composer catalog`) in light and dark mode, with the keyboard
- [ ] Every commit is signed off (`git commit -s`), see CONTRIBUTING.md
